findings.area: Progress vault, leaderboard, student with 0 XP in a class that has ranked students
findings.title: An unranked 0-XP viewer is shown as a rank ("#39 You 0 XP") and counted in "Showing 21 of 38 ranked students"
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/lb3.mjs (fresh student joins demo class CG67C4, 38 ranked): API me.rank 39, total 38, rows 20; UI shows '... #20 Jade G. | ... | #39 | You | 0 XP | 0 labs | Showing 21 of 38 ranked students.'; screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/shots/lb3-unranked-bigclass.png; small class variant /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/shots/lb-tiny-peersZero.png ('#3 You 0 XP' under two ranked peers, other 0-XP classmate invisible).
findings.expected: docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS (R12-C-08): a viewer without XP is not ranked; the client should not print a 'N of M ranked' line for them and should not present total+1 as a real rank (e.g. 'Not ranked yet').
findings.actual: BoardRow prints '#' + me.rank for everyone and describeBoard counts the unranked row in 'shown', so the line claims 21 of 38 ranked students include the viewer, and the viewer reads as 39th of 38. With total 2 and rows 2 the viewer shows '#3' and the count line is silently dropped.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/progression.ts describeBoard (~line 110) and web/src/pages/progress.tsx BoardRow: when me.xp === 0 (or me.rank > total) render 'Not ranked yet' instead of '#rank', exclude the row from 'shown', keep the gap marker.

findings.area: Progress vault, leaderboard, class where nobody has XP yet
findings.title: A student who IS in a class but nobody has XP is told the leaderboard appears 'when your learning group is set up'
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/lb1.mjs soloZero: API cohortAvailable true, total 0, me.rank 1; UI 'The leaderboard is not available yet / The class leaderboard appears when your learning group is set up.'; screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/shots/lb-phone-soloZero.png
findings.repro: node /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/lbmk.mjs then node /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/lb1.mjs (token soloZero: teacher creates a class, one fresh student joins, nobody earns XP).
findings.expected: A message that matches the situation, e.g. 'Nobody in your class has earned XP yet. Complete a mission to appear here.'
findings.actual: describeBoard folds total === 0 into 'unavailable', so a joined student is told their group is not set up yet.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/progression.ts describeBoard: separate cohortAvailable === false from total === 0 and give the second its own copy (progress.tsx BoardPanel ~line 190).

findings.area: Leaderboard abbreviated names (server shortName) for students with emoji, ZWJ, flag, ß or digraph initials
findings.title: The abbreviated name takes the first code point of the last word, so initials break: 'Max 👨.' (family emoji cut), 'Zoe 🇫.' (half a flag), 'Ana ‍.' (zero-width joiner, blank initial), 'Hans SS.', 'Ali DŽ.'
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/nm2.mjs (API names printed with code points) and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/shots/names-initials.png
findings.repro: Register students named 'Max 👨‍👩‍👧fam', 'Zoe 🇫🇷France', 'Ana ‍‍z', 'Hans ßtraße', join one class, earn XP, open Progress.
findings.expected: One user-perceived character (grapheme) as initial, never a joiner or a lone regional indicator.
findings.actual: Game.shortName spreads the string into code points ([...s][0]) and upper-cases it; the front end already has a grapheme helper for avatars (web/src/ui/common.tsx) but the backend does not use Intl.Segmenter.
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts shortName (~line 789): use Intl.Segmenter('en',{granularity:'grapheme'}) and skip zero-width/joiner-only segments.

findings.area: Mission player, hint focus restore at the 900px breakpoint
findings.title: After the learner clicks an empty area (focus on BODY), crossing 900px still pulls focus onto the hint button
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-B/bp.mjs output: 'after click empty BODY' then 'empty-click then narrow: BUTTON.hint:Ask Lab Assistant'
findings.repro: Open a mission at 1100 wide, focus Ask Lab Assistant, click blank page area (focus goes to body), resize to 768.
findings.expected: Only focus that was ON the hint button when the layout flipped is restored; a learner who clicked away keeps no focus claim.
findings.actual: hintHadFocus is only cleared by a focusin elsewhere, never by a blur to body, so a stale 'had focus' flag steals focus (and may scroll) on the next crossing. Cosmetic: no keyboard trap, no wrong action.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/mission.tsx ~line 90: also clear hintHadFocus on document 'focusout' when relatedTarget is null, but record it only if the hint button is the focusout target AND it is still in the document at the time of the media-query change (e.g. read document.activeElement inside the matchMedia handler before React unmounts).
